dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is one of the locations Mr. Elber marked for us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: See the footprints by the puddle? Did the Sumpter Beast leave that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If it trod in the puddle, there would be water on the hooves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh, it's time to use Elemental Sight! Follow the water's trail and we'll find the beast.
